up: Retrieve activity data for compounds tested against human TRPV1 (target CHEMBL4794) where the activity type is IC50 and the standard units are nM. Join compound structures to get the canonical SMILES string, and join documents to verify the publication has a PubMed ID or DOI. Return the compound's ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, assay description, target name, and target organism. Only include rows where the canonical SMILES is not null and the document has a non-null PubMed ID or DOI.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, cr.compound_key, a.standard_value AS ic50_value, a.standard_relation, ass.description AS assay_description, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism AS target_organism FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4794' AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_units = 'nM' AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL AND (d.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR d.doi IS NOT NULL)
